said.details:
How The Training Estimates Are Worked Out: Each estimate is your recent work judged again as you are now, with the hours of practice added. It’s what that would be worth a piece, in points of the whole, with the latest piece counting most. For composure, 9 of your last 12 pieces call on it; Three Sisters would gain most, about +0.7. About 0.8 of its estimate comes from the discipline that 20 days of practice build, which any exercise kept up daily would bring too. Set Focus to Steady to start. Spaced pays more once your last session is a day to a week old. It’s an estimate, made only from the work on your record, and the work you do next may call on different things.
What It Assumes Of Your Work: Of your last 12 pieces, 8 were fully prepared, and 4 were underprepared but are counted as fully prepared. In Heightened Text Scene, revised, rehearsal stood at 0% and work with your partner at 0% of the way to complete. In Table Work, making your choices stood at 0% and the revision at 0% of the way to complete. In A Game Played Through, work with your partner stood at 43% of the way to complete. In A Voice Sequence, knowing the material stood at 100% and rehearsal at 0% of the way to complete. The forecast counts those pieces as fully prepared, since their own preparation held each back most. Counted as they were, 20 hours of composure would be worth about 1.31 points a piece, not 1.38. None of them depends on knowing a genre. Apart from training, fully preparing the 4 pieces held back most by their own preparation would bring them about 10.12 points a piece as you are now. That’s preparation, not training, and it isn’t part of composure’s estimate.
Preparation Or Training: Both preparation and training are worth your time now, preparation more: coming to your recent work fully prepared would have added about 10.12 points a piece as you are now (all of it from each piece’s own preparation), and 20 hours of composure would add about 1.38 points a piece.
From Your Record: What held your last piece back most was discipline, but it isn’t what pays most to train now: it would pay less to train than composure. Composure is called on by more of your recent work, or has more room to grow.
Other Things Worth Your Time: Making your choices: Going in short on it cost your recent work about 1.9 points a piece off the whole. Composure, Graded Exposure at the Developing tier: an estimated 1.4 points a piece for 20 hours, from 48 to about 52. Imagination, The Given Circumstances at the Developing tier: an estimated 1.1 points a piece for 20 hours, from 61 to about 64. Work with your partner: Going in short on it cost your recent work about 1.1 points a piece off the whole.
